svg.title: keyguard: your keys never reach GitHub
svg.desc: A lime centipede crawler climbs through a dim GitHub repository page in a figure eight: up and down the file tree, across the lines of one open file, up and down the commit history, and across the file again. Six masked API keys sit in the code. Each one lights up in place with a thin neon outline as the crawler reaches it, then settles to a quiet mark. The keyguard wordmark and the line Your keys never reach GitHub. sit in the top left corner. Violet neon tubes glow along the top and bottom edge.
